findings.diagnosis: PAY, 'Accept card payments', schedules BANK, the unfamiliar bank API integration, after UI and COPY. BANK depends on an external team and has no de-risking spike, so integration failures would be discovered only after the preceding work, delaying payment delivery and leaving little time to change approach.
findings.recommended_action: Propose moving BANK earlier or scheduling a small integration spike before committing to the full sequence, while respecting human-set ordering.
